name: PageMate
description: Read pages aloud with your own Kokoro server, save them as PDF/Word/Markdown, download course media, keep study notes, and investigate: lookups, archives, screenshots and sealed evidence.

_execute_action.description: Open the PageMate toolbox (pick a tool, then press its letter)

read-page.description: Start / stop reading this page aloud (reads the selection if text is selected)

save-page.description: Save this page as PDF / Word / Markdown

save-video.description: Download a video from this page

toggle-notes.description: Open / close the Notes sidebar on this page

screenshot-region.description: Screenshot: select an area of the page

investigate.description: Investigate this page (entities, lookups, archive, site profile)

record-screen.description: Record the screen, a window or a tab

screenshot-visible.description: Screenshot: the visible part of the page

lookup.description: Look up an address, name, domain, number…

archive.description: Archive this page (find or make saved copies)
